notes.title: Arca's Path Update - 10th Jan 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32972215/b2aab0742778ffae07a9ea63f23870b96e8419da.png[/img]

Early media reviews have been positive, and highlighted how good Arca's Path is for those new to VR games which is exactly what we had in mind whilst developing the game.

Now the holidays have gone and we're back to work, we have today pushed a small patch with some minor game-play bug fixes that most won't notice but being the perfectionists that we are was needed.

We hope you enjoy the challenges of Arca's Path and solving its puzzles.

notes.title: Controller-free VR adventure Arca's Path releases on December 4th!
notes.content:
[b][i]Arca's Path VR[/i][/b], the innovative new game where you use your gaze to navigate a mysterious world, is coming to all major VR platforms on December 4th, 2018. 

Today's brand new trailer sheds more light on what to expect from the game. In [i]Arca's Path VR[/i], you don't need a controller to play. To navigate the world and its rich labyrinth of puzzles and challenges, you simply look towards where you want to go, and your digital avatar will roll in that direction.
 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m5peuPpQM2I
You play as a young girl who finds herself in a beguiling, beautiful new world. But as you wander further down the path, the beauty around you begins to crumble and the road ahead becomes more treacherous. Skill, instinct and awareness will help you navigate the path and find your way back home. 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QNCoCYO.jpg[/img]

Arca's Path VR will be playable at [b]EGX 2018[/b], starting today and running through to Sunday, September 23rd. Play the same demo that the Telegraph called "[i]an oasis of calm[/i]" and UploadVR described as "[i]one of the most comfortable and relaxing experiences I've ever tried in a VR headset.[/i]" Head over to the Rezzed area to try the game and meet the development team!
 
Dream Reality Interactive are also hosting a panel on VR in 2018 at EGX this afternoon. The panel featuring Head of Art Laura Dodd, Head of Production Sitara Shefta and Creative Lead Albert Bentall begins at 2pm BST and will be streamed live on the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/egx]EGX Twitch channel[/url].
